name: OmaLumineCapture
author: Bram van Oploo
description: LumineCapture integration for Omarchy: bar launcher with automatic AUR dependency installation, a conflict-checked global shortcut per capture mode, and a full configuration panel for LumineCapture

barWidget.description: LumineCapture launcher with AUR auto-install, per-mode keybindings and configuration

schema.label: Capture keybindings
schema.description: Global shortcut per capture mode (editor, full, window, region, region-ocr). Empty disables that mode's binding. Edited in the plugin panel.

schema.label: Mode
schema.description: What the launch captures. Empty opens the editor.

schema.label: Only the monitor under the pointer
schema.description: Capture the screen the pointer is on, instead of every screen.

schema.label: Delay (seconds)
schema.description: Take the shot this long after the launch, e.g. 3 or 0.5. Empty takes it straight away.

schema.label: Send to
schema.description: What to do with the shot. Empty keeps the app's own choice.

options.label: Copy
options.description: put the image on the clipboard

options.label: Save
options.description: write it to the output folder

options.label: Stdout
options.description: hand the PNG to a command on stdout

options.label: Primary selection
options.description: the middle-click target, only Region OCR acts on it

schema.label: Nothing happens when you finish
schema.description: Finishing a shot does nothing unless you choose, whatever the app's own setting says.

schema.label: Output folder
schema.description: Save the shots here, created if missing. A folder here also saves the shot, even when Save is not ticked.

schema.label: No notifications
schema.description: Skip the saved / copied / OCR outcome notifications.

schema.label: OCR daemon
schema.description: Run the background OCR engine instead of a capture.

options.label: serve
options.description: Keep a ready engine in the background

options.label: status
options.description: Report whether the daemon is running

options.label: calibrate
options.description: Measure this machine and pick CPU or GPU
